title: Maintenance Mode
default_message: We're performing scheduled maintenance. Please check back soon.

source.memory_warning: Running on memory fallback — changes lost on restart

message.label: Maintenance message
message.placeholder: We're performing scheduled maintenance. Expected back: 14:00 UTC

allowed_ips.label: Allowed IPs (CIDR notation, one per line)
allowed_ips.help: IP ranges allowed to bypass maintenance mode. Supports IPv4 and IPv6 CIDR notation.

schedule.title: Scheduled maintenance
schedule.help: Maintenance mode turns on automatically from start to end. Enter dates in your local time.

memory.title: Memory fallback active
memory.description: Maintenance mode is running on memory fallback because Redis is unavailable. Configuration was explicitly set by an admin during Redis outage. Will sync to Redis on recovery.

redis_down.title: Redis unavailable
redis_down.description: Cannot connect to Redis. Maintenance mode is running on memory fallback with safe defaults (maintenance OFF).
redis_down.help: Check Redis connection. Admin changes during outage will be pushed to Redis on recovery.
